title: PIV SELECT: add bounds check after ber_len_decode advances pos
description: wp11_proto_piv.c wp11_piv_select() calls ber_len_decode then advances pos without verifying pos <= body_len before the subsequent linear scan loop. The while condition catches it, but a malformed card FCI with a crafted length field could cause pos to equal or exceed body_len before the loop is entered, and the first iteration of the inner TLV scan reads resp[pos] at the boundary. Add: if (pos > body_len) break; after the advance.
